og.alt: Query: TanStack Query, minus the re-render. 1 vs 8 field derivations when a component reading every field sees new data, against @tanstack/react-query.

hero.alt: Schematic: a cached query for ['user', 7] goes stale, refetches from the server, and the new name flows to the one reader of data().name. The isFetching reader blinks while loading; the error reader never runs.
